title: /ship
line: Check the behavior, push the commit, and trace CI to its SHA.

beats.caption: You ask Pi to ship the greeting change.
The CLI check passes on your machine.
A focused commit goes to the demo remote.
The sample CI result is tied to that commit.

takeaway.title: Keep the evidence separate
takeaway.line: Report what ran locally and what checked the pushed commit.

title.text: Slash ship takes a change from a local check to a pushed commit. Here, the change adds a shout flag to a tiny command line app.

scene.text: Pi runs the tests, stages three files, and pushes a focused commit to a disposable remote. The hosted CI response is a labeled fixture for the exact commit that arrived.

takeaway.text: When you ship, keep the local result and hosted status separate. Check the commit that actually reached the remote.
